query: SELECT i.resource_id AS "resource_id!: Uuid" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT resource_id FROM role_resource_permissions_include WHERE role_id = $1) i INNER JOIN resource r ON r.id = i.resource_id AND r.workspace_id = $2 AND r.deleted IS NULL AND r.id <> r.workspace_id UNION SELECT r.id FROM resource r WHERE r.workspace_id = $2 AND r.deleted IS NULL AND r.id <> r.workspace_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_permissions_exclude e WHERE e.role_id = $1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_permissions_exclude e WHERE e.role_id = $1 AND e.resource_id = r.id);
